item.content:encoded:
"A barren rock. Home to terrors beyond imagining. It is well that life has fled. It is even better that life for others continues far away from this place."

"Is there a future for humanity on Earth?"

Oh my dear O-5, you may know not what you have done…The line before this interaction being phrased with, "411, does humanity exist in your past?", makes me think that the O-5 messed up, here. She should've responded with 'was there a past for humanity on Earth', if I understand 411 correctly. With how she asked it, it sounds like she got information about Earth's past, where she wanted information about Earth's future. By the sound of it, the implication is that things have gone to hell before, that what was here before us peaced out.

That, or it was a slip of the mind by the writer. Either or!

item.content:encoded: I took it to mean that she wants to believe that there is a chance escaping, which is better than killing off the majority of the human race.

item.content:encoded: Overall I enjoyed this quite a lot, but it feels a little silly to me that an O5 would casually write off anything that 411 says in a time of crisis like this. I'd buy that there's not enough time to work out what it means before tomorrow's vote, but instantly deciding on "oh he's senile" instead of even "I'll work out whether or not that means anything later" was a little tough to swallow.
